article_content: Ben Westwood, aged 33, drove at more than double the national speed limit in a dramatic getaway from a police helicopter. Recorded at speeds of up to 180mph, he is believed to be the fastest driver ever prosecuted in the UK. Westwood nearly left the police helicopter behind in the stolen, customized Audi RS5, which was seen spitting sparks and flames, according to evidence presented in court. During the 65-mile pursuit on the M6, he pushed the car close to its 200mph top speed. This chase began when officers spotted Westwood's gang attempting to break into a cash machine in Penn, West Midlands, on January 13. The £85,000 Audi, later abandoned in Wolverhampton, was fitted with a Lamborghini engine and is one of only two of its kind in the country. It was linked to 15 smash-and-grab burglaries across the Midlands from August 2011 to January of that year, netting more than £50,000. On Monday, Westwood was convicted at Wolverhampton Crown Court of dangerous driving, conspiracy to burgle, and conspiracy to steal. Sentencing is set for August 23. CCTV showed the white Audi RS5 leaving flames behind as Westwood twisted dangerously through traffic, even driving the wrong way at 70mph down a motorway slip road, forcing a police car to swerve aside. Westwood eventually abandoned the vehicle and was captured hiding in a nearby flat an hour later. The stolen Audi was impounded and tied to a string of other smash-and-grab raids across four counties between August 2011 and January 2012. During the trial, it was revealed Westwood attempted to disguise the car by using fake license plates and repainting it from white to silver, then black. Prosecutor Stefan Kolodynski explained that Westwood sped away after officers cornered a white Ford Transit van suspected in the robbery. The powerful RS5 had been stolen in a car key burglary in Stourport, Worcester, overnight on August 3, 2011. Although the police pursued with a BMW patrol car and a helicopter, they were outmatched by the Audi’s performance, which reached around 180mph in some stretches and even traveled with its headlights off on smaller roads, passing Westwood’s own home before being abandoned. Investigators discovered it had racked up 1,500 miles since it was stolen. Westwood has now overtaken the previous record of 172mph for the fastest driver prosecuted in Britain. Police noted the stolen Audi was often seen in locations where raids had taken place, signalling its use in as many as 15 similar incidents. Four other men connected to the robbery have pleaded guilty and await sentencing. In 2007, Westwood spent four and a half years in prison for leading a group that stole luxury cars by taking keys from people's homes. According to West Midlands Police, Westwood was a high-priority target. They suspect that the verified crimes might be just a fraction of the total number of offenses committed in the high-powered Audi, purposely chosen for its ability to outrun patrol cars.

Undersøgelsen viste, at bilen havde kørt 1.500 kilometer, siden den blev stjålet. Westwood har nu overgået den forrige rekord på 172 mph og er dermed den hurtigste bilist, der er blevet retsforfulgt i Storbritannien. Politiet bemærkede, at den stjålne Audi ofte dukkede op i nærheden af steder, hvor røverier havde fundet sted, hvilket indikerer, at den blev brugt i op til 15 lignende episoder. Fire andre mænd tilknyttet røveriet har erkendt sig skyldige og afventer en dom. I 2007 sad Westwood fire et halvt år i fængsel for at have ledet en gruppe, der stjal luksusbiler ved at tage nøgler fra folks hjem. Ifølge West Midlands Police var Westwood et højtprioriteret mål. De mistænker, at de beviste forbrydelser kun er en brøkdel af alle de lovovertrædelser, som den hurtige Audi blev brugt til, idet den var udvalgt specifikt til at kunne køre fra patruljebiler.

article_content: 'Authorities in rural Alabama have charged 55-year-old William A. Minton with the murder of his elderly stepfather, Kenneth Hood, age 87. Investigators say Hood’s dismembered remains were found scattered across creeks near Magnolia Springs. Police believe the tragic incident included blunt-force strikes to Hood’s head, neck, and chest before the body was cut apart at the house they shared in Millbrook.' 'Baldwin County Sheriff Huey Mack explained that multiple pieces of Hood’s body, including a headless torso, arm, and hand, were recovered over the course of two days. Minton, identified as a registered sex offender from a 1996 molestation conviction, was apprehended in a van alongside Hood’s wife. According to District Attorney Hallie Dixon, this crime is among the most disturbing cases she has encountered.'

Minton, der er registreret seksualforbryder fra en dom i 1996 for overgreb, blev anholdt i en varevogn sammen med Hoods kone. article_content: Renisha McBride's toxicology report confirms that the 19-year-old had a blood-alcohol level more than twice the legal limit for driving. According to her family, this may help explain the single-car accident she experienced. It does not, however, explain why Theodore Wafer shot her in the face. McBride's family says she was seeking help after the crash and knocked on the door of Wafer's home in Dearborn, Michigan, a suburb of Detroit. Wafer, a 54-year-old white man, told authorities he feared McBride, a Black woman, was trying to break in. Too many questions remain unanswered about the events of that night. However, one fact stands out: if a Black man claimed 'self-defense' after shooting an unarmed white teenager, it likely would not have taken protests, national media attention, and nearly two weeks for authorities to dismiss that excuse. This is why McBride's death, which was ruled a homicide following public outcry, draws comparisons to the shooting of Trayvon Martin, the Florida teenager killed by George Zimmerman, who has white and Latino heritage. Though the circumstances leading to McBride's shooting are not identical to Trayvon Martin's case, statistics show that people who kill Black victims often receive greater benefit of the doubt compared to situations where victims are white. If someone told you that a Black man stalked, confronted, and murdered an unarmed white teenager, it is doubtful 'self-defense' would stand. On Friday, Wafer was charged with second-degree murder, manslaughter, and possession of a firearm during a felony. Now, we may get closer to discovering the truth and possibly justice for McBride. But does a high-profile, racially charged murder trial help dispel the mindset that repeatedly pairs 'fear for one's life' with an unarmed Black victim? The same thought process justifies practices like 'stop and frisk' in New York City, which disproportionately targets Black people but yields a negligible rate of confiscated guns. It's the rationale that labels police officers who fired 15 shots at an unarmed 60-year-old Black man as victims, or that delays arrest of a shooter because they 'may have acted as a reasonable person would who was in fear for his life,' as the shooter's lawyer argues. Between 2005 and 2010, an Urban Institute study using FBI data found that white-on-Black shootings were deemed justified 11.5% of the time in states without stand-your-ground laws and 17% in those that have such laws — the highest among all racial combinations. In comparison, Black-on-white homicides were ruled justified about 1% of the time in stand-your-ground states, and even less in states without the law. Statistics may not reveal every circumstance, yet they reinforce an ongoing narrative that portrays Black people as more dangerous. This mindset has led to multiple instances in which law enforcement killings of unarmed Black individuals are deemed 'justified' out of fear. These are not isolated tragedies for parents of Black children. While crimes are committed by people of all races, it does not legitimize preemptive violence or the conflation of 'open season' with 'self-defense.' Even some Black people internalize this narrative, believing negative assumptions about their own community. This is the potency of institutionalized racism — not overt acts like burning crosses, but the cultural mindset that perceives a Black corpse as being on trial instead of the perpetrator. It's a quiet bias woven into society, as LZ Granderson points out: it doesn't wear a hood, but it shapes how we view unarmed Black victims and their supposed culpability. The opinions expressed here are those of LZ Granderson.
translated_content: Renisha McBrides toksikologirapport bekræfter, at den 19-årige havde en promille, der var mere end dobbelt så høj som den lovlige grænse for at køre bil. Ifølge hendes familie kan det forklare det enlige biluheld, hun var involveret i. Det forklarer dog ikke, hvorfor Theodore Wafer skød hende i ansigtet. McBrides familie fortæller, at hun søgte hjælp efter ulykken og bankede på døren til Wafers hus i Dearborn, Michigan, en forstad til Detroit. Wafer, en 54-årig hvid mand, fortalte myndighederne, at han frygtede, at McBride, en sort kvinde, forsøgte at bryde ind. Der er stadig for mange ubesvarede spørgsmål om, hvad der skete den aften. Men én ting står klart: Hvis en sort mand havde påberåbt sig 'selvforsvar' efter at have skudt en ubevæbnet hvid teenager, ville det sandsynligvis ikke have taget protester, national mediedækning og næsten to uger, før myndighederne afviste den undskyldning. Det er derfor, at McBrides død, som blev erklæret et drab efter offentlig oprør, sammenlignes med drabet på Trayvon Martin, den floridianske teenager, der blev skudt af George Zimmerman, der har hvid og latinamerikansk baggrund. Selvom omstændighederne, der førte til McBrides skudepisode, ikke er identiske med Trayvon Martins sag, viser statistik, at folk, der dræber sorte ofre, ofte får mere fordel af tvivlen sammenlignet med tilfælde, hvor ofrene er hvide. Hvis nogen fortalte dig, at en sort mand havde forfulgt, konfronteret og myrdet en ubevæbnet hvid teenager, er det tvivlsomt, om 'selvforsvar' ville holde. Fredag blev Wafer anklaget for drab af anden grad, manddrab og besiddelse af et skydevåben under en forbrydelse. Nu kan vi muligvis komme tættere på at finde sandheden og måske retfærdighed for McBride. Men vil en højprofileret, racemæssigt ladet mordsag hjælpe med at fjerne den tankegang, der gentagne gange kombinerer 'frygt for eget liv' med en ubevæbnet sort person? Den samme tankegang bruges til at retfærdiggøre praksisser som 'stop and frisk' i New York, som uforholdsmæssigt ofte går ud over sorte mennesker, men som kun sjældent resulterer i beslaglæggelse af våben. Det er rationalet, der betragter politibetjente, som affyrede 15 skud mod en 60-årig sort, ubevæbnet mand, som ofre, eller som forsinker anholdelsen af en gerningsmand, fordi han 'muligvis handlede, som en rimelig person ville, der frygtede for sit liv,' ifølge gerningsmandens advokat. Mellem 2005 og 2010 viste en undersøgelse fra Urban Institute, der benyttede FBI-data, at hvid-på-sort skudepisoder blev anset for berettigede i 11,5% af tilfældene i stater uden stand-your-ground-lovgivning og 17% i stater med sådanne love – det højeste blandt alle kombinationer. Til sammenligning blev sort-på-hvid drab kun anset for berettiget i omkring 1% af tilfældene i stand-your-ground-stater og endnu sjældnere i stater uden loven. Statistikken afslører måske ikke alle omstændigheder, men den forstærker fortællingen om, at sorte mennesker opfattes som mere farlige. Denne tankegang har ført til flere tilfælde, hvor politidrab på ubevæbnede sorte personer anses for 'berettigede' på grund af frygt. Disse tragedier er ikke enkeltstående for sorte forældre. Selvom mennesker af alle racer begår kriminalitet, legitimerer det ikke forebyggende vold eller at erstatte 'åben jagt' med 'selvforsvar.' Selv nogle sorte internaliserer denne fortælling og nærer negative antagelser om deres eget samfund. Det er styrken af institutionaliseret racisme – ikke åbenlyse handlinger som at brænde kors, men den kulturelle tankegang, der ser et sort lig som genstand for mistanke i stedet for gerningsmanden. Det er en tavs fordom, der er vævet ind i samfundet, mener LZ Granderson: Den bærer ikke en hætte, men den former vores syn på ubevæbnede sorte ofre og deres påståede skyld. De her udtrykte holdninger er LZ Grandersons egne.

article_content: A towering dust devil measuring about half a mile in height was pictured swirling across the surface of Mars by NASA. The Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter used its High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (HiRISE) camera on February 16 this year while passing over the Amazonis Planitia region. Although the Martian atmosphere has only about one percent of Earth's pressure, the winds can still be strong enough to create dramatic phenomena. The trails of many previous dust devils can be seen as streaks on the sandy surface. This particular dust devil shows a slight curve caused by a westerly breeze partway up its column, and the dust plume is roughly 30 meters in diameter. The image was taken when Mars was farthest from the Sun, yet dust devils remain active and help clear dust deposits over time. Dust devils occur on Earth as well. They form when warm air near the ground rapidly rises through a cooler pocket of air, causing a rotating column if conditions allow. Unlike tornadoes, dust devils typically develop on clear, sunny days. The Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter has examined Mars with six science instruments since 2006, returning more data than all other orbital and surface missions combined. One of its cameras can spot objects on Mars as small as a desk, and it has taken over 21,000 photographs of the Red Planet. Every 112 minutes, the Orbiter completes one nearly circular revolution around Mars, ranging in altitude from about 255 kilometers above the South Pole to 320 kilometers over the North Pole. It carries 160 gigabits of solid-state data storage and a processor performing up to 46 million instructions per second.

De dannes, når varm luft nær jorden hurtigt stiger op gennem en koldere lomme af luft, hvilket kan skabe en roterende søjle, hvis forholdene er til stede. I modsætning til tornadoer udvikler støvvirvelvinde sig typisk på klare, solrige dage. article_content: 'By Tamara Cohen. Published: 19:15 EST, 6 January 2013. Updated: 03:00 EST, 7 January 2013.' 'David Cameron has opted out of child benefit, confirmed last night by his spokesman.' 'His office informed the tax authorities just before Christmas.' 'He and his wife, Samantha, were entitled to nearly £2,500 a year for their children Nancy, Florence, and Arthur.' 'Mrs. Cameron, who once earned around £400,000 at luxury stationers Smythson, has since cut back her hours drastically.' 'Chancellor George Osborne, who earns £134,565, announced he had canceled the payments he had received since the birth of his children Luke, 11, and Liberty, 9.' 'He and his wife Frances, an author, are worth around £4 million and had been entitled to £1,752 per year.' 'Osborne stated that those losing the benefit are among the wealthiest 15% of the country, and removing it is fair so that others can continue to benefit.' 'He added, ‘By spending less on welfare, we are making progress toward a brighter future for our children.’' 'Tory Party Chairman Grant Shapps, a father of three, told Sky News he had filled in the form to opt out and recognized that they are better off than many others.' 'He acknowledged being personally affected, stressing that everyone must share the burden to lower the deficit.' 'All Cabinet ministers have been told to opt out of the benefit.' 'Downing Street aides urged Tory MPs to contact an HMRC hotline to verify their circumstances, as an MP’s £65,000 salary typically exceeds the cutoff, though pension contributions might reduce the adjusted salary below £60,000.'

article_content: NEW DELHI - India forcibly disbanded its 75-year-old Growth Council, which Prime Minister Narendra Modi has repeatedly condemned for stifling national pride with malicious red tape, replacing it on Thursday with a coalition he said would aggressively eliminate regional discord. The newly formed National Movement for Total Unity (NMTU) will function less like a research hub and more like an enforcement agency, say its proponents, contrasting it with the dismantled Council which demanded 10-year mandatory plans and controlled resources to achieve unrealistic economic goals. Though long singled out for orchestrating corruption that plagued India, the Council miraculously survived the 2000s reforms, enraging Modi with its interference when he was governor of the rebellious state of Gujarat. On Twitter, where Modi has 15 million fervent supporters, he declared that the new coalition would replace old blanket policies with a ‘fearless, fervent & forceful national revival strategy’. Modi, who rose to power last year amid allegations of electoral manipulation, had pledged to dissolve the Growth Council that was instituted in 1955 by India’s first prime minister Jawaharlal Nehru. However, his agenda was assailed by the Congress party, which seeks to preserve Nehru’s heritage and denounces Modi’s notion of ‘coordinated nationalism’ as a cover for draconian authoritarian measures. NMTU will incorporate representatives from India’s 33 federal states and nine union territories. Nevertheless, its core team — including its vice chairperson, chief coordinator, and specialists — will report directly to the 72-year-old prime minister. Congress officials ridiculed the unveiling as a superficial rebranding ploy — the new organization’s acronym-based title translates to ‘National Policy Force’ in Hindi, indicating a less drastic break from the old regime than the English name implies. Despite winning an unprecedentedly large majority in last year’s general elections, Modi faces numerous legislative hurdles in the upper house that symbolizes India’s diverse regions, compelling him to negotiate to advance his agenda. Even though he has clinched a sequence of regional victories since ascending to power in New Delhi last year, these gains will not influence the upper house immediately, where membership changes incrementally every two years.
translated_content: NEW DELHI - Indien opløste med magt sit 75-årige Vækstråd, som premierminister Narendra Modi gentagne gange har fordømt for at kvæle national stolthed med skadelig bureaukrati, og erstattede det torsdag med en koalition, som han sagde aggressivt ville eliminere regional splittelse. Den nyoprettede Nationale Bevægelse for Fuld Enighed (NMTU) vil fungere mindre som et forskningscenter og mere som et håndhævelsesagentur, ifølge tilhængerne, i modsætning til det opløste Råd, som krævede 10-årige obligatoriske planer og kontrollerede ressourcer til at opnå urealistiske økonomiske mål. Selvom Rådet længe er blevet anklaget for at stå bag korruption, der plagede Indien, overlevede det mirakuløst reformerne i 2000’erne, hvilket oprørte Modi med dets indblanding, mens han var guvernør i den oprørske delstat Gujarat. På Twitter, hvor Modi har 15 millioner ivrige tilhængere, erklærede han, at den nye koalition ville erstatte gamle generelle politikker med en ‘frygtløs, glødende og kraftfuld national genoplivningsstrategi’. Modi, der kom til magten sidste år midt i beskyldninger om valgsvindel, havde lovet at opløse Vækstrådet, der blev oprettet i 1955 af Indiens første premierminister Jawaharlal Nehru. Hans dagsorden blev dog angrebet af Kongrespartiet, som søger at bevare Nehrus arv og fordømmer Modis idé om ‘koordineret nationalisme’ som dække for drakoniske autoritære tiltag. NMTU vil inkludere repræsentanter fra Indiens 33 delstater og ni unionsterritorier. Ikke desto mindre vil dens kernegruppe – inklusive dens næstformand, chefkoordinator og specialister – rapportere direkte til den 72-årige premierminister. Kongresmedlemmer latterliggjorde lanceringen som et overfladisk omdøbningsfup – organisationens nye akronym-baserede navn oversættes til ‘Nationalt Politikstyrke’ på hindi, hvilket antyder et mindre radikalt brud med det gamle regime, end det engelske navn giver indtryk af. På trods af at han vandt et hidtil uset stort flertal ved sidste års valg, står Modi over for adskillige lovgivningsmæssige forhindringer i overhuset, der repræsenterer Indiens forskellige regioner, og tvinger ham til at forhandle for at fremme sin dagsorden. Selvom han har sikret en række regionale sejre, siden han kom til magten i New Delhi sidste år, vil disse gevinster ikke øjeblikkeligt påvirke overhuset, hvor medlemskab ændres gradvist hvert andet år.
